args.body:
Dear New Car Rental Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inquire whether you offer child seats for your rental vehicles in London.

If child seats are available, I would appreciate it if you could let me know:
1. What types of child seats you offer (e.g., infant seats, booster seats)
2. Whether there is an additional charge for renting a child seat
3. How I can request a child seat when making a reservation

Thank you in advance for your assistance. I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Inquiry About Child Seat Availability
